item.description:
Untiring 0.13.0

AwakeMac is now Untiring, with a new home at untiring.app.

  • The menu-bar panel, Settings, and license screen now use the Untiring name.
  • Your saved preferences and existing license remain compatible.
  • Sessions and optional closed-lid protection work as before.

Requires macOS 14 or later and a valid license. Supports Apple silicon and Intel.

AwakeMac 0.12.6

  • A simpler license screen with a compact layout, one key field, and a clear Activate button.
  • Clearer first-time closed-lid setup: one relevant action at a time for setup, approval, or repair.
  • Centered session guidance with a brief horizontal nudge when a session cannot start. Respects Reduce Motion.
  • A clean settings icon in the menu-bar panel.

Sessions, license activation, and Settings stay inside the menu-bar popover.

Requires macOS 14 or later and a valid AwakeMac license key. Supports Apple silicon and Intel.

AwakeMac 0.12.5

Session controls, license activation, and Settings now stay together in the menu-bar popover. No separate app windows open alongside it.

Opening AwakeMac from Spotlight or Applications shows the popover, including after activation. Launch at login stays quiet. The panel cannot be detached into a separate window.

Open Settings in the panel to switch between General, Closed Lid, and License. Use Back to return to your session.

Requires macOS 14 or later and a valid AwakeMac license key. Supports Apple silicon and Intel.
